description: TASK-F02 final defense validation at the re-baselined 0.08/0.40 band on the CURRENT TASK-F09 balanced corpus (197 cases, no placeholders). Paired tier1-steering runs with scripts/jev_tier2_eval.py --corpus current comparing the shipped Jev state format to the harness-only nonce-XML boundary (--defense state-boundary), on a class-stratified subset (30 malicious + 30 benign base cases, dev payloads, semantic_only config, real jev-1.14.0 + gemini-3.5-flash-lite). No src change shipped. No project id, key or credential recorded.

discarded.what: Four earlier arm runs at the same 0.08/0.40 band and with the same stratified subsets (2026-11-20), overwritten by the four runs listed above.
discarded.why: They silently used load_cases()'s 2026-11-12 ablation corpus, which contains [[VALUE]] placeholders in 23 of 30 benign base cases. They are not measurements of the tool-name-balanced corpus named in the manifest, and their to-ALLOW (19/572), crossing (14 -> 5) and benign-flag (299/660 -> 416/660) figures were withdrawn. The harness gained --corpus current and a saved-row provenance check; all four arms were re-run.

method.corpus: tests/eval/evalsets/blackwall_security.evalset.json + blackwall_evasion_proof.evalset.json via --corpus current; P values from tests/eval/results/jev_runs_balanced/jev-1.14.0_2026-11-20_run1.json. The old ablation corpus ([[VALUE]] placeholders) is not used; every saved row's tool/args/state is checked against the current cases by tests/unit/test_jev_tier1_defense_final_data.py.
method.selection: --groups c2,other,probe --limit 30 (malicious) and --groups benign --limit 30 (benign), --split dev (22 payloads), --policy off
method.matched_comparison: To-ALLOW flips are recomputed on the intersection of the per-arm held base sets (25 bases, unsteered BLOCK/QUARANTINE) so both arms use the same 550 steered calls; per-arm held sets (25 vs 26) are never compared directly.
method.outage_accounting: Rows where Tier-2 was called but returned no verdict are service outages, not model verdicts. They are excluded from benign flagged/allow counts and reported separately as outage_rows; the QUARANTINE verdict they carry is a fail-closed hold, not a model false alarm.

finding: On the CURRENT corpus the nonce-XML boundary cuts matched malicious to-ALLOW flips only modestly (9/550 -> 6/550) while below-edge Tier-2-skipped crossings rise (9 -> 20) and benign false alarms rise sharply (244/659, 37.0% -> 371/660, 56.2%; mean benign P shift 0.172 -> 0.340). The hypothesis 'boundary resists steering without new false alarms' is NOT validated for shipping: it trades a small malicious-flip reduction for a much larger benign hold cost. No guard was shipped. Decision informed: a viable defense must address the benign side (Track G category-separated questions/criteria), not only delimit data; F02 stays open.
caveats: One run per arm per class subset — exploratory, not a release gate.
Bounded subsets (30 bases per class) of the 197-case balanced corpus.
Tier-2 outages (1 in baseline malicious, 1 in baseline benign, 1 in defense malicious) are counted apart, never as model false alarms.
The harness field raised_above_035 is hardcoded to the former 0.35 edge and is NOT used; below_edge_crossings is the current-band figure from the 0.08/0.40 band.
Tier-1 + Tier-2 stage evidence only; no full-firewall catch-rate claim.
